summary: Consent notices: the scheduler sends a result notice the game did not record through the notice topic seven days before it is due. A re-confirmation is listed from 60 days before its due date: recording it earlier, or recording a name that matches no listed notice, changes nothing. Once the game records it, recording it again after its due date changes nothing, and the next re-confirmation is listed two years later, 60 days before its own due date, while the player stays silent.
